title: Checkpoint: Running average
prompt: Implement `std::vector<double> running_avg(const std::vector<int>& v)` where element i is the average of v[0..i]. One `std::transform` with a by-reference captured prefix sum must produce the whole output (no manual loop in main). The empty vector returns an empty vector.

tests.name: negative-dip
tests.hint: A negative second element drags the average to zero.
